name: GJ 412 A
description: A nearby red dwarf, 40% of the Sun's width: its disc was measured by interferometry.

radius.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 757, 112, Table 6, GJ 412A: radius in solar radii, 0.3982 +/- 0.0091, from this work (CHARA)

mass.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 757, 112, Table 6, GJ 412A: mass 0.403 solar masses from the K-band mass-luminosity relation of Henry & McCarthy (1993), not a dynamical mass

temperature.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 757, 112, Table 6, GJ 412A: effective temperature in K, 3497 +/- 39, from this work (CHARA)

text.card: A nearby red dwarf whose disc was measured by interferometry: 40% of the Sun's width.
text.introduction: Interferometry gives it 0.3982 solar radii; with its total light, that makes its surface 3,497 K.
